definition: Additional pretraining of an existing model on targeted data: a new domain (legal, medical), a new language, or long-context extension.
details: Additional pretraining of an existing model on targeted data: a new domain (legal, medical), a new language, or long-context extension. The middle ground between pretraining from scratch and light fine-tuning, and the standard route to strong domain or language adaptation (highly relevant for Arabic-focused models).
